The '''Green Mazes''' were large mazes located within the [[Trophill Gardens]]. The challenge of the mazes required participants to carry [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] to alert managers for a rescue. Over half the people who entered the mazes required a rescue.<ref name="CatCW" />
